scope: Regulatory/screening source corrections only; no live screening, comprehensive jurisdiction survey or legal certification.
date_semantics: Null dates mean not established or no single applicable date; publication, effective, compliance and review dates are not interchangeable. READ means page/PDF retrieved; SEARCH_EXCERPT means only indexed primary-source text was inspected. UNAVAILABLE records failed access, not absence of a rule.
